==Description==
The '''UFO''', which stands for '''<u>U</u>nidentified <u>F</u>lying <u>O</u>bject''', was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared in [[Area 51]] as part of the [[Area 51 Event]]. It had a similar speed as the [[Lawnmower]], but had more health. This meant that it was a difficult enemy to kill without preparation.

==Appearance==
The '''UFO''' was a grey metallic flying vehicle, resembling a flying saucer. It had a blue glow around the sides.

==Strategy==
*[[Units]] can collide with the '''UFO''', as its hitbox is below the mesh.
*Being slow, it means that high damage towers, such as the [[Sentry]] and [[Ranger|Outlaw]], can be used to effectively kill the '''UFO'''.
*The [[Freezer]] and [[Pyromancer]] can be used to slow the '''UFO''' down. Interestingly, the [[Freezer]]'s ice crystals appear directly below the '''UFO'''.

==Trivia==
*The '''UFO''' used the mesh of the {{RLinkC|163352376|Personal UFO}} gear in the Roblox catalog.
*The '''UFO''' was the first "flying" [[Enemies|enemy]] in the game.
**However, the first true flying enemies were the [[Bat (Nightmare Carnival)|Bat]] and [[Witch (Trick or Threat Town)|Witch]] as those enemies were immune to collisions, at least partially.
***The actual [[Flying]] attribute was not introduced until [[Hardcore Testing BETA]], making the [[Balloon]] and [[Lead Balloon]] the first enemies with [[Flying]] attribute.
